drivers: Petcoke rally above US$100 on energy complex strength
outlooks.summary: Headlines are mixed: some outages and high freight, but several coker restarts. Price is down 16% over 3 months, and the rally looks demand/energy-led rather than a clear shortage.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch whether freight rates ease and whether Deer Park and other US Gulf coker outages last.

drivers: Chinese prebaked anode above RMB 6,000 on feedstock rally
outlooks.summary: Feedstock strength and higher anode costs add some support, and the price is up 15% already. Supply headlines are mixed and mostly refinery-related, so there is no clear shortage signal.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch green coke feedstock prices and whether anode cost pressure keeps rising.

outlooks.summary: The index is up 46% over 12 months, so much of the tightness looks priced in. Recent news is a mix of outages and restarts, with a supply-pressure score near zero.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch US Gulf Coast coker run rates and freight rates for heavy oil and petcoke.

drivers: DRC export quotas cutting output (Glencore down 52%)
China critical mineral export controls nearing deadline
outlooks.summary: DRC quotas are clearly cutting supply and Glencore's output has roughly halved. Price is down 24% over 3 months, so there is room to rebound if quotas keep biting.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch DRC quota allocations and export volumes, plus China's export-control deadline decisions.

drivers: A copper-moly major slowing molybdenum output growth
outlooks.summary: Slower moly output growth and export-policy uncertainty are mildly bullish. Price is already up sharply, so part of the move looks priced in, and the headlines are mostly generic critical-mineral news.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch China's export-control deadline decisions and moly output guidance from copper miners.

drivers: CATL investing in upstream lithium capacity
outlooks.summary: Headlines are mostly broad critical-mineral policy news with nothing lithium-specific on supply cuts. New upstream investment is mildly bearish, and the price is up 71% over 12 months.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch China's export-control decisions and any lithium mine or conversion supply disruptions.

drivers: Yttrium supply 'stalled', Japan months from running out
Controls pause extended to January, but only for some buyers
outlooks.summary: Yttrium shortages and targeted controls on Japan point to real physical tightness. The two-month extension for the US, India and Europe eases pressure somewhat, and the price is up 36% over 12 months, so some of this is priced in.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch for any change in China's export licensing for Japan and the January suspension deadline.

drivers: Congo conflict and Indonesia cuts squeezing supply
outlooks.summary: Supply disruptions in Congo and Indonesia are the most direct bullish factor. Price is up 56% over 12 months but only 1% over 3 months, so more upside is possible if the disruptions persist.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Congo conflict developments and Indonesian export and output data.

outlooks.summary: An export deadline is approaching, which is mildly bullish. Prices have fallen sharply and the headlines are mostly generic, so there is no clear shortage signal yet.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the antimony export deadline outcome and any new Chinese licensing rules.

drivers: China export deadline for gallium on November 27
Rising indium prices and tight minor-metal supply
outlooks.summary: Export-control deadlines and tight minor-metal markets support further upside, and demand from AI power and chips is growing. Price is already up 67% in 3 months, so part of the shortage is priced in.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch China's November 27 gallium deadline and any new export licensing decisions.
